strings.en: With Zemon, I shall become ruler/　of countless star systems.
Become a cornerstone of my great ambition.
Twice now, God has granted me Zemon,/　and commanded me to forge a new future.
The weak simply vanish like dew on the battlefield.
The Arounzer "Floraga" has no blind spots.
Only the chosen can master Zemon.
Zemon is my power.
Behold the fruits of my research.
Before my Floraga, not even a corpse remains.
Even if I must build a mountain of corpses,/　my great ambition must be fulfilled.
You'll lie dead before me, along with Fairy Klibia.
Swing your fists and raise your swords as you will;/　before me, it is mere reckless bravado.
I won't let a woman like you hinder my plans.
Fairy Klibia... For a traitor, there is only death.
Fierce firepower and sturdy armor alike/　are powerless before me.
I won't forgive anyone who turns a bow on Gadisword.
Even with the Steel Dragons in tow,/　your fate remains unchanged.
Gallant ornaments mean nothing on a weapon.
Know that nothing surpasses the Arounzer's firepower.
So you dare leap into the jaws of death?
Learn firsthand what comes of your folly.
A small matter before a great one./　I won't let a single weakling escape.
There is no escaping this Arounzer.
If you stand in my way, you must disappear.
Only a fool relaxes after seizing the initiative.
Fools, clinging to a sliver of hope...!
Those who desecrate my research/　shall be led into the abyss.
I-I! Zemon! All of it...!!
My Floraga cannot possibly be defeated...!
As long as I have Zemon, Floraga will...!
The Siebe Drive's output is dropping...?!/　I'll have to switch to the auxiliary engine.
I seek to control Zemon./　I am well aware of the risks...!
Nngh... I must draw more power from Zemon!
This much... I can still recover!
I have received a divine revelation!/　I will not end in a place like this!
With the Siebe Drive,/　I could crush you all in an instant...!
I have power... absolute power!
That Siebe Drive gives this much power...?!/　Impossible!
Fairy Klibia.../　How long will you keep defying me...!
My plans must never be thwarted/　by those traitors of Anex...!!
Traitor, will you keep heaping sin upon sin?!
So this is the power... Golaikunru feared?!
Hardly any damage.
A suicide attack? Then I'll kill you as you wish.
The longer this drags on, the worse it is for you.
Don't forget: you stand at the brink of death.
Perfect prey for proving my power.
The Siebe Drive's output shows no problems.
Hmph, so your recklessness reached me.
Floraga's durability is proven.
Even with a Siebe Drive on board,/　the gap in power is obvious.
I have no more attachment to that Siebe Drive.
Building in a Siebe Drive to fight me.../　What shallow cleverness, Fairy.
Traitor of Anex... What an eyesore.
Who but I/　do you think could lead Gadisword?
Not even the power of the Granzon/　can stop this Floraga.
Only this Floraga can control Zemon's power.
You defy me with that little power?
Is that your best?
It stands beside Zemon. This is no ordinary armor.
I can't even evaluate performance like this.
Hmph... No need to use the Zemon Mortar.
Do you think you've exhausted every option?
Lackluster attacks are useless, no matter how many.
Floraga's range of movement is limited now.../　Some hits are to be expected.
Even with that Siebe Drive,/　you cannot defeat the Floraga.
Fairy, the Siebe Drive you stole/　is merely a miniaturized prototype.
Whatever a mere rebel does is futile.
Traitor, have you no shame?
The boasts of the powerless are unbearable.
An attack all bluster and no substance.
The culmination of my research cannot be pierced!
Keep making a spectacle of yourself, Masoukishin.
Even the Granzon is powerless before me.
You're no match.
Laughable...
You are no enemy of mine.
You should have known Floraga's position well.
You can't master the Siebe Drive.
You can't so much as touch me, boy.
You'll never reach me... ever.
Such futile struggling...
None can touch the Floraga.
My schemes are flawless.
No need to even dodge.
I can't be bothered with the tactics of the weak.
Is this a fool's idea of an answer?
All I need is to buy time.
This is the real attack!
Things won't go your way.
I won't let up until you're dust on the battlefield.
I show no mercy to those who resist.
The weak shall simply vanish!
Rabble, be gone!
Take this! Arounzer Inferno!
Behold my power!
Taste boundless terror!
Burn the fools to ashes!
Inexhaustible power is in my hands!
Arounzer, destroy thine enemies!
Now, prepare yourself!
It's futile, wherever you flee.
Perish without a shred of hope!
Bold and daring may sound nice, but...
This is the result of recklessness!
I have no interest in your drivel...
And I have nothing to say to those about to vanish!
I'll show you the Siebe Drive's true worth.
Zemon! Grant me power!
This battle that spits at the heavens...
Praising recklessness as courage!
Glorifying death is the act of fools!
I'll teach the ignorant what absolute power is.
Zemon! Grant me light!
A herd of worthless fools...
I can no longer bear the sight of you!
Behold my power, my wrath!
